alert.drive_better.msg: The drive looks better than before.
alert.drive_temp.crit.title: Drive {dev} is too hot ({temp}°C)
alert.drive_temp.msg: Drive {dev} reached {temp}°C. Check that the fans run and the vents are free.
alert.drive_temp.warn.title: Drive {dev} is running hot ({temp}°C)
alert.drive_verdict.msg: {summary}. Open Drive Health for what to do.
alert.drive_verdict.msg_plain: Open Drive Health for what to do.
alert.drive_verdict.title: Drive {dev}: {label}
dh.f.attribute_failing.action: Copy what matters on it to another drive or a backup now, then replace it.
dh.f.attribute_failing.title: A health value is below the maker's limit
dh.f.cable_errors.action: Reseat or replace the SATA cable, or move the drive to another bay.
dh.f.cable_errors.detail: {rising, plural, one {# transfer error} other {# transfer errors}} in the last {days} days ({total} in all). The drive itself is fine; the data got garbled on the way.
dh.f.cable_errors.title: Errors on the cable to this drive
dh.f.cable_errors_old.detail: {n, plural, one {# transfer error was} other {# transfer errors were}} counted at some point, none in the last {days} days.
dh.f.cable_errors_old.title: Old cable errors, none lately
dh.f.command_timeouts_few.action: Nothing to do unless other errors appear; then check its cables.
dh.f.command_timeouts_few.detail: Command timeouts: {n}. Usually a loose cable, a weak power supply or a busy controller.
dh.f.command_timeouts_few.title: A few commands timed out at some point
dh.f.command_timeouts_growing.action: Reseat the data and power cables, or try another port.
dh.f.command_timeouts_growing.detail: {rising, plural, one {# timeout} other {# timeouts}} in the last {days} days ({total} in all). Usually a loose cable, a weak power supply or a busy controller.
dh.f.command_timeouts_growing.title: Commands to the drive keep timing out
dh.f.command_timeouts_many.action: Reseat the data and power cables, or try another port.
dh.f.command_timeouts_many.detail: Command timeouts: {n}. Usually a loose cable, a weak power supply or a busy controller.
dh.f.command_timeouts_many.title: Many commands to the drive timed out
dh.f.end_to_end.action: Copy what matters on it to another drive or a backup now and replace the drive.
dh.f.end_to_end.detail: End-to-end errors: {n}. The drive's own path from cache to disk is faulty.
dh.f.end_to_end.title: Data got corrupted inside the drive
dh.f.fine.title: No sign of trouble.
dh.f.no_recent_test.action: Run a long self-test (it runs in the background; the drive stays usable).
dh.f.no_recent_test.detail: A long self-test reads the whole surface and finds bad spots before your files do.
dh.f.no_recent_test.title: No self-test lately
dh.f.nvme_backup_failed.action: Keep it on a UPS and plan a replacement.
dh.f.nvme_backup_failed.detail: Data in its cache may be lost in a power cut (critical warning bit 4).
dh.f.nvme_backup_failed.title: The SSD's power-loss protection failed
dh.f.nvme_degraded.action: Copy what matters on it to another drive or a backup now, then replace it.
dh.f.nvme_degraded.detail: Its own reliability flag is set (critical warning bit 2).
dh.f.nvme_degraded.title: The SSD reports it is no longer reliable
dh.f.nvme_media_errors.action: Copy what matters on it to another drive or a backup now. If the count rises, replace it.
dh.f.nvme_media_errors.title: The SSD could not read some data
dh.f.nvme_media_errors_growing.action: Copy what matters on it to another drive or a backup now. Plan to replace it.
dh.f.nvme_media_errors_growing.detail: Media errors: {n}, {rising} of them in the last {days} days.
dh.f.nvme_media_errors_growing.title: The SSD could not read some data and it is getting worse
dh.f.nvme_read_only.action: Copy everything off it, then replace it.
dh.f.nvme_read_only.detail: It no longer accepts writes, to protect what is on it.
dh.f.nvme_read_only.title: The SSD has switched itself to read-only
dh.f.nvme_spare.action: Copy what matters on it to another drive or a backup now, then replace it.
dh.f.nvme_spare.detail: Spare blocks left: {spare}% (the maker's limit is {limit}%).
dh.f.nvme_spare.title: The SSD has run out of spare blocks
dh.f.nvme_wear.detail: {used}% of its rated writes are used up.
dh.f.nvme_wear.title: The SSD is wearing out
dh.f.nvme_wear_past.action: Replace it soon; it can fail without warning now.
dh.f.nvme_wear_past.detail: {used}% of its rated writes are used up.
dh.f.nvme_wear_past.title: The SSD is past its rated life
dh.f.old_drive.action: Nothing urgent. Keep backups current and budget for a replacement.
dh.f.old_drive.detail: Powered on for {years} years. Failures become more likely after five.
dh.f.old_drive.title: An old drive
dh.f.reallocated_growing.action: Copy what matters on it to another drive or a backup now and plan to replace it.
dh.f.reallocated_growing.detail: {rising, plural, one {# sector was} other {# sectors were}} replaced in the last {days} days ({total} in all). A drive that keeps doing this usually fails within months.
dh.f.reallocated_growing.title: The drive keeps replacing worn-out sectors
dh.f.reallocated_many.action: Keep backups current and plan a replacement.
dh.f.reallocated_many.detail: {n, plural, one {# sector was} other {# sectors were}} replaced over the drive's life. The count is stable for now.
dh.f.reallocated_many.title: Many sectors have been replaced
dh.f.reallocated_stable.action: Nothing to do now. If the number starts to rise, replace it.
dh.f.reallocated_stable.detail: {n, plural, one {# sector was} other {# sectors were}} replaced and the number has not moved in the last {days} days. That alone is not a reason to replace the drive.
dh.f.reallocated_stable.title: Some sectors were replaced, a while ago
dh.f.self_test_failed.action: Copy what matters on it to another drive or a backup now, then replace it.
dh.f.self_test_failed.title: Its last self-test failed
dh.f.smart_failed.action: Copy what matters on it to another drive or a backup now, then replace it.
dh.f.smart_failed.detail: Its own health check (SMART overall status) says FAILED.
dh.f.smart_failed.title: The drive reports that it is failing
dh.f.spin_retries.action: Check the power cable and supply; if they are fine, copy what matters on it to another drive or a backup now and replace the drive.
dh.f.spin_retries.detail: Spin-up retries: {n}. A weak motor or a power problem.
dh.f.spin_retries.title: The motor needed several tries to spin up
dh.f.spin_retries_growing.action: Check the power cable and supply; if they are fine, copy what matters on it to another drive or a backup now and replace the drive.
dh.f.spin_retries_growing.detail: Spin-up retries: {n}, {rising} of them in the last {days} days. A weak motor or a power problem.
dh.f.spin_retries_growing.title: The motor needed several tries to spin up, more of them lately
dh.f.ssd_wear.detail: About {left}% of its life is left ({attr}).
dh.f.ssd_wear.title: The SSD is wearing out
dh.f.too_hot.action: Check that the fans run and nothing blocks the airflow. Heat shortens a drive's life.
dh.f.too_hot.title: The drive is too hot
dh.f.unread.title: No reading of this drive yet.
dh.f.unreadable_sectors.action: Copy what matters on it to another drive or a backup now. Run a long self-test, and plan to replace the drive.
dh.f.unreadable_sectors.detail: {n, plural, one {# sector} other {# sectors}} could not be read back. Files there may already be damaged.
dh.f.unreadable_sectors.title: Parts of the disk could not be read
dh.f.unreadable_sectors_worse.action: Copy what matters on it to another drive or a backup now. Run a long self-test, and plan to replace the drive.
dh.f.unreadable_sectors_worse.detail: {n, plural, one {# sector} other {# sectors}} could not be read back. Files there may already be damaged.
dh.f.unreadable_sectors_worse.title: Parts of the disk could not be read and it is getting worse
dh.f.warm.action: Check the fan curve and the airflow around it.
dh.f.warm.detail: {temp} °C now; below {limit} °C is better for its life.
dh.f.warm.title: The drive runs warm
